what: Step-by-step: updating a value for a new ASTM edition
title: Updating Determinability, Repeatability, and Reproducibility Values
text: Suppose ASTM revises repeatability limit base oils 40 C 1.01% , say, 1.05%. full process: Open R/utils.R editor find repeatability table inside .default_sample_rules(). Locate row "base_oil" temp_min_c temp_max_c 40. Change coefficient_a 0.0101 0.0105 (1.05% expressed decimal fraction, matching every row written). Update notes column row cite new edition value, e.g. "D445-27 17.2.1: base oils 40 C (1.05 %)".
